name: Rodrigo Oler
title: Rodrigo Oler — Senior Engineer · 3x Co-Founder · 2x CTO
description: Senior software engineer, founder, and CTO focused on scalable products, editorial systems, SEO-first publishing, and fast-moving product teams.
availability: Open to senior/lead engineering, founding teams, and selective consulting.

experience.summary: Built scalable Web3 delivery in a Turborepo and Next.js monorepo, reduced bridge flows by 60-70%, and cut CI/CD time by about 85%.
Took a high-frequency OTC platform from MVP to more than $200M in volume with Fireblocks, multi-region AWS, Terraform, and a strong release cadence.
Strategic equity holder supporting fundraising, investor conversations, and product direction after helping build the platform and delivery pipelines.
Embedded across several client products, delivering product builds, automation, and AWS consulting in short and medium-term cycles.
Led frontend delivery for a blockchain game powered by HVM, while shipping internal tools and reusable UI systems.
Built low-latency trading systems with CCXT and Node.js for OTC and copy-trade workflows, plus remote-first delivery and blockchain consulting.
